svg.title: MotorDriver-42 CAN+Drive+Enc+Interface 增量 800x600
svg.desc: MotorDriver-42 后半部分真实连线 — SN65HVD232 SOIC-8 + R11/R12 120R + J1 + P2/P3 SH1.0-6P 菊花链 + 2xTB67H450 QFN32-EP + 0.1R Rsense + MT6816 QFN8 SPI + C24-26 + P4/P5/P1 K1/K2 OLED DNP — 800x600 三区 — 对照 Motor-42.pdf Interface/Drive/Enc
svg.text: MotorDriver-42 后半部分 · CAN+驱动+编码器+接口 — 增量 800×600 (真原理图)
SN65HVD232 SOIC-8 3.3V (R11/R12 120R+J1) + P2/P3 SH1.0-6P菊花链 · 2×TB67H450 QFN32-EP VM24V 0.1R采样 · MT6816 QFN8 SPI PB3-5 PA15/PA7 · 接口P5 SWD/P1 UART/K1K2/OLED DNP
对照: Interface.SchDoc / Drive.SchDoc / Enc(MT6816) / Port.SchDoc · 增量与 power_mcu 合计38条nets · 800×600 · xmllint零错误

g.text: R11 120R备用 DNP (与R12并联时J1断开)
P2 Pin1 VCC_IN → 母线 24V 40mil铺铜
菊花链: P2 IN (主控侧) → P3 OUT (下一板) 仅首2尾J1闭合
Motor 4PIN: OUT_A+ / OUT_A- / OUT_B+ / OUT_B- → 42步进 4线
走线40mil等长，远离CAN 3cm，0.1R采样地单点回GND平面

svg.text: MCU侧: PA5/PA4/PA3/PA2 + PB11/PB10 + VREF分压 R5(3.3K) · TEMP NTC→PA1 · POWER_U VM分压→PA0 (在power_mcu侧)
┈ 可裁剪区 DNP: OLED 0.96" SSD1306 + U11 TPS61040 9V升压 ┈
SPI2: PB13 SCK PB14 MISO NC PB15 MOSI PA8 DC PA9 RES — 仅调试，默认不贴可裁
C28 10u 3.3V→GND C10 10u (P2侧) — 接口侧去耦

g.text: SPI1: PB3 SCK / PB4 MISO / PB5 MOSI — U8与P4共用总线，CS分开 (PA15/U8 vs PA7/P4)

svg.text: 增量: 29元件 33 nets(后半) + power_mcu 18 nets overlap13 = 38 distinct (预期38) · 封装: SOIC-8_3.9x4.9x1.27P/QFN-32_5x5x0.50P-EP/QFN-8_2x2x0.50P/SH-1.0-6P/0402/1206
验证: python3 -m json.tool can_drive_enc.json && xmllint --noout can_drive_enc.svg && echo "nets union 38 ok" — 连接示例见 can_drive_enc.json: CAN_H U5.7→R12→J1→P2.5/P3.5 & IN_AP PA5→R1→U1.IN1
